question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Disposed
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Disposed"** means inclined, willing, or having a particular tendency towards something. (इच्छुक)

 
 
• **Example:** She was **disposed** to help the needy whenever possible.
 
 
 
• **"Retained"** means to keep possession of something or to continue to have it. (रखना या बनाए रखना)
 
 
• **Example:** The company **retained** its top employees despite financial challenges.
 
 
 
• Hence, the opposite of "**Disposed**" (inclined or willing) is "**Retained**" (keeping or holding back).

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Minded** (मन का या इच्छुक): Having a particular mindset or inclination towards something.

 
 
• **Example:** He is very open-**minded** and willing to try new things.
 
 
 
• **Detained** (रोकना): To keep someone from proceeding or to hold them back, often in custody.
 
 
• **Example:** The police **detained **the suspect for further questioning.
 
 
 
• **Pretended** (दिखावा करना): To behave as if something is true when it is not.
 
 
• **Example:** She **pretended **to be asleep when her mother entered the room.
